cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.3.3 FATAL_ERROR)

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/import-std.cmake)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

project(libtooling VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

# ---- C++20/23 module library ----
# `libtooling.cc` is a module wrapper generated by modulizer's `--wrapper`
# mode: it re-exports the clang/llvm types the library needs via
# `using ::clang::...;` declarations so consumers can `import libtooling;`.

add_library(libtooling STATIC libtooling.cc)
target_sources(libtooling PUBLIC FILE_SET CXX_MODULES FILES libtooling.cc)

# ---- Dependencies ----
# When consumed via CPM the parent project may have already located LLVM/Clang.
if(NOT LLVM_FOUND OR NOT Clang_FOUND)
  find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
  find_package(Clang REQUIRED CONFIG)
endif()

target_link_libraries(libtooling PUBLIC clang-cpp LLVM)
target_include_directories(libtooling PUBLIC
  ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
  ${CLANG_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
target_compile_features(libtooling PUBLIC cxx_std_23)

# The companion macro header (macros cannot be exported from a module).
# Consumers that need it can `#include "libtooling_macros.h"`.
set_target_properties(libtooling PROPERTIES
  PUBLIC_HEADER libtooling_macros.h
)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS libtooling
  EXPORT libtoolingTargets
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  PUBLIC_HEADER DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
  FILE_SET CXX_MODULES DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/libtooling
)
install(EXPORT libtoolingTargets
  FILE libtoolingTargets.cmake
  NAMESPACE libtooling::
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/libtooling
)
